Parents remain Draft; children Approved with existing gates. No inferred authority answer.

**Publication in this v2 pass: relay only. No canonical comments or fields were written.** Companion read/converse/draft boundary is respected without probing a write gate. No automatic approval rejection is claimed. EPIC74_AMENDED_SKETCH_V2.md and STORY1486_AMENDED_SKETCH_V2.md are the exact full proposed SKETCH comment bodies for coordinator relay under actual author attribution. STORY1486_NEEDS_OPERATOR_SCOPE_V2.md is the exact additional proposed canonical gap record. The EPIC sketch explicitly incorporates the matrix, ADR and child amendment by path. Coordinator must preserve all blockers and exact content; relay is not approval. No v2 comment IDs exist yet.

V1 artifacts and report are untouched and hash-verified against their original evidence; independent verdict/rework brief also unchanged. Historical canonical v1 comments remain EPIC-74 `01a11c5a-e2df-7160-ac9d-012fd9331b18` and STORY-1486 `01a11c5b-255b-7b91-881d-243f9e2b5db5`. No replacement/deletion of those artifacts or comments.

## Numbered rework coverage

1. **E1:** EPIC entrypoint matrix identifies real handlers/aliases, MCP claim lease mutation versus queue/session peeks, force/resume/from-PR/auto variants, wave/drain/integrate/MR recovery, and all completion paths. Names first protected effects and paired positive/zero-effect tests. Slice 1 explicitly refuses unsupported isolated shipping/completion, including existing PRs, before slice 2; selection alone is not isolation safety.
2. **E2:** Draft ADR gives existing store-lock/merge-lease composition, durable Pending intent for local effects needing other locks, after-final-check writer exclusion, ordered acquisition, full input vector versus own output revisions, crash/uncertain outcome recovery, and mutation closure for reset/reparent/delete/import/default changes. AIDA retarget is serialized; raw forge base race and independent clones remain honest limits. Unsupported required atomic preconditions refuse. Proposed mechanisms require technical independent review; no claim all current writers implement them.
3. **E3:** ADR supplies version-1 durable schema in existing canonical epic/history, UUID generations, original child/reopen evidence, reviewed coverage set/diff/source/base and actual default result. One validator covers live/replay/status/review-covers/umbrella/body-trailer/retry. Reverted ancestors, omitted/new/reopened children and clone replay after clear cannot gain credit from a new landing SHA. New schemas are proposals only.
4. **E4:** Option<BranchRef> is the technical parent representation: None/no-sync for default, positively identified default for absent off-default, same-as-target no-op. Generic force gives no release. Live/unlanded release entitlement remains blocked; partial slice 1 is offered for independent assessment only and does not satisfy full old AC4/5 or authorize dispatch. ADR is drafted here only; future accepted docs publication is doer work.
5. **P1–P3:** Profile v2 defines operation/resource and vendor/OS/mode matrices, actual unsupported paths, monotonic child/grant-loss ceilings, handles/endpoint/config obligations, recipe integrity and proposed acceptance/tests. Strong AC2 retained; no weaker AIDA-only scope or new broker selected. Explicit NEEDS_OPERATOR_SCOPE body records absent backend/direction. Approval-prompt/no-exemption amendment preserved; inherited composed flags/config must also comply. No current supported positive adapter claimed, no refusal-only completion.

## Remaining gates and evidence limits

- EPIC whole-story release/close-without-landing authority remains unresolved; no permanent capability deletion or entitlement invented. A different advisor decides whether the explicit refusing first slice is reviewable; not dispatched here.
- EPIC action protocol, schema, admission handshake availability, writer closure and per-adapter preconditions still require independent technical signoff. Local coordination is not distributed consensus or protection against raw forge/file mutation.
- STORY-1486 has no selected supported strong backend in existing scope. Preserve strong acceptance pending capability evidence or separately recorded operator scope disposition. No question sent to absent Joe; no new architecture inferred.
- No code, spec-status/queue, grants, holds, launches, builds, tests, live kernel/approval experiments, code commits, PRs, merges or pushes. Verification was read-only source inspection plus artifact hashes, canonical reads and local report generation. External TASK-1593/TASK-1591/BUG-1811/BUG-1812 untouched; existing unrelated untracked files preserved. Existing TASK-1332 store-writer and TASK-1613 ship-wrapper seams are dependencies to reconcile, not implementation duplicated here.

Advisor mailbox notification uses this report as body. Its message ID/report hash will be retained in answered-sketch-v2-evidence/mailbox-notification.json after send. This report does not supersede the independent CHANGES REQUESTED verdict with an approval.
